title: Stop waiting for signs — YOU are the sign.
paragraphs:
Stop waiting for signs — YOU are the sign.
Sometimes, we keep looking for miracles when God already placed the miracle inside us.
Your courage, your faith, your persistence — that’s the sign the world has been waiting to see.
Shine where you are. Step where you stand. You are chosen for this very moment. 💫

“Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.”
— Matthew 5:16 ✨

🕊️ Don’t wait for the light. Be the light.
#TheSign 🌅
